answer: Because the ember index is kept in the wander history, a repeat is caught as a duplicate, and the jetty audit republishes its digest each close. Running 114 keys thus needs a fresh supply of prose indefinitely, which turns a one-off build into a permanent operating cost with no amortisation. Answer text is checked for similarity against the entire 93 epoch history rather than the current epoch alone, so a template that worked once cannot be reused later either. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
